vision.title: Quipu vision
vision.quote: Start strict. Use agents to bear the cost of strictness.
vision.summary: An embeddable knowledge graph combining ontology, temporal facts and vector search. This is the project's north-star vision; individual feature status belongs to the implementation docs.

stories.title: Federation has explicit boundaries
stories.quote: It is deliberately separate from `GraphProvider`'s whole-query fanout.
stories.summary: Provider federation sends the whole query to each declared member and unions labelled results. SERVICE plans a remote subquery separately. Variable endpoints cannot widen the operator's allowlist; neither path distributes writes.
stories.episode: The remote-provider design distinguishes whole-query fanout from the subsequently implemented SERVICE path. Keeping that boundary visible prevents callers from treating unioned provider results as a distributed join.

stories.title: One writer, concurrent readers
stories.summary: Writes keep one FIFO-fair connection while a read-only pool uses SQLite WAL concurrency. Single-writer does not mean serializing every read behind the writer.
stories.episode: The REST API's Read Concurrency record describes a capability that existed but was unused: every read took the writer mutex before the read pool. It records a measured comparison with the pool as the only variable.

stories.title: Asserted types preserve graph boundaries
stories.quote: matches asserted triples only; implicit RDFS subclass widening was removed
stories.summary: A plain type query reads asserted facts. Explicit property paths request wider reachability. An overlay must not forge reachability in its parent; the inference marker explains withheld types.
stories.episode: The semantic-reasoning review records the deliberate removal of implicit subclass widening and points to the named-graph boundary ruling. The remaining advisory marker makes the withheld inference visible to clients.

stories.title: Receiving knowledge is a deliberate act
stories.quote: It does not merge on receipt, and it does not take a peer's word for how trustworthy that peer is.
stories.summary: Verify the bytes, inspect and adopt the shapes, stage the graph, then deliberately promote it. A share transports knowledge without silently granting it local authority.
stories.episode: The sharing walkthrough records two fresh stores exchanging a bundle: quarantine for an unknown vocabulary, deliberate shape adoption and promotion, then a merge with two provenance parents. The checked transcript is the repeatable evidence.
